cells.source_rule: Sometimes required indirect page reference (#431): child Pg takes precedence over containing structure element Pg; required when the containing element has no Pg.

cells.assertion: The relevant mixed-child test omits OBJR `/Pg`, so it tests inheritance; its MCR states the same page 3 as its containing element. cells.source_rule: Required indirect reference to referenced object.

cells.assertion: Mixed-child test, page-to-element ParentTree tests, viewer-core annotation rectangle/control test, and tagged-copy tests exercise identity through distinct model, UI and copy consumers.

notes.source_rule: OBJR identifies entire objects only; if only part of an object's stream is content, use marked-content sequence.
notes.evidence: ADR 1970 and existing object/appearance sequence tests preserve sequence coverage vs whole-object text.

notes.source_rule: An object rendered on multiple pages needs a separate reference per page; multiple renditions on one page need only one OBJR. If distinguishing renditions of the same XObject matters, use MCRs enclosing particular Do invocations.
notes.evidence: Current logical-range code de-duplicates a named object once, consistent with ADR 1970. The source note defines the structure-reference distinction, not a separate geometry/location for each Do invocation.

features.ledger: doc/conformance/ledger.toml clause 14.7.5.3 is implemented; it names structure::Child::Object, page placement, annotation/control consumers, and Table 358 Pg errata. Clause 14.7.5.4 separately owns reverse ParentTree lookup.

selected_assertions.finding: Mixed child enum and object ID are asserted, but fixture parent Pg and MCR Pg agree; OBJR omits child Pg and inherits. Not a Table 358 precedence test.
The OBJR participates in a ParentTree route, but its `/Pg 3` matches the containing element's `/Pg 3`; it does not test conflict precedence.
This asserts annotation_rectangles only; the test body has no StructTreeRoot/OBJR and is not evidence for Table 358 page semantics.
Strong public consumer oracle for literal annotation bounds, widget control and non-widget annotation; page relation is not the competing-page case.
Literal copy result supports single-object de-duplication, but does not cover multiple XObject Do placements.
